Name: Eyjafjalla to the Farm
Author: kawaillusion
Description:
This mod takes 6 Star operator Eyjafjalla from the Gacha game Arknights and makes her a dateable character (just because personal interest), with slight tweaks to Demetrius and Krobus.

Clarification: No event yet, She is initialized in abigails room, visiting stardew valley for scientific purposes.

Update: Full timing this piece of art again. Please stay tuned for update. This will be a major update consisting of me fixing EVERYTHING that has happened before because guess what I use a windows now so its better for me just to rewrite the whole mod. Lol.

Also. I will still be trying my best to make the mod in english, because although i believe the majority of the user is chinese, i cannot put myself to the situation that I have to sacrifice the few english users of this mod.
